title: gossypium peruvianum subsp. racemosum
intro: Gossypium peruvianum subsp. racemosum, commonly known as Peruvian thistle, is a plant species belonging to the cotton family (Malvaceae). It has been traditionally used in folk medicine to treat various health issues, such as inflammation and fever, due to its health benefits, which include antioxidant, anti-inflammatory, and antimicrobial properties. The therapeutic actions of this plant include its ability to reduce inflammation, fight against infections, and exhibit antioxidant effects. The bioactive constituents of Gossypium peruvianum subsp. racemosum include flavonoids, alkaloids, and terpenoids, which contribute to its medicinal properties.
